231    /**
232     * Return a boolean, true or false.
233     *
234     * @param int $chanceOfGettingTrue Between 0 (always get false) and 100 (always get true)
235     *
236     * @return bool
237     *
238     * @example true
239     */
240    public static function boolean($chanceOfGettingTrue = 50)
241    {
242        return self::numberBetween(1, 100) <= $chanceOfGettingTrue;
243    }
